claims.head: The Wild want Kaprizov head to head with Knies
claims.call: The Wild’s L1 (Ek, Kaprizov and Boldy) spends at least 54% of its 5-on-5 time against the Blue Jackets’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Wild keep sending Kaprizov’s line (Ek, Kaprizov and Boldy) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. John Hynes has been choosing strength on strength. Tonight the Blue Jackets’ first line is Johnson, Knies and Fantilli.

claims.gist: At home, John Hynes likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Blue Jackets’ first line.

claims.head: The Blue Jackets’ defense joins the attack, the Wild’s stays home
claims.body: The Blue Jackets’ defensemen shoot a lot, and the Wild’s not so much. Columbus is one of the league’s best for shots from defensemen, and Minnesota is the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Watch the Blue Jackets’ defensemen jump into the play.

notes.text: Ivan Provorov is on injured reserve (lower body injury) and has not played this season. He is a top-four defenseman. Zach Werenski has taken his spot beside Denton Mateychuk.
Marcus Foligno is on injured reserve and has missed the last 4 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Jared Spurgeon is out (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-four defenseman. Jonas Brodin has taken his spot beside Quinn Hughes.
Brock Faber is on injured reserve (skull surgery) and has not played this season. He is a top-pair defenseman. Jonas Brodin has taken his spot beside Quinn Hughes.
Tyler Pitlick was added to the roster on Oct 13 and has played beside Michael McCarron and Yakov Trenin.

MIN.head: The Wild have a slight edge
MIN.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Even though Columbus gets Andrae back, Minnesota has home-ice advantage. The Blue Jackets can still swing it if they keep dangerous shots away.

items.text: The Wild are newly without Jared Spurgeon, have been without Marcus Foligno since Oct 8, and have had to make do without Filip Gustavsson and Brock Faber all season. Jesper Wallstedt is expected to start.
The Blue Jackets have been without Ivan Provorov all season.
Matt Boldy has a point in five straight games against Columbus, and 13 points in his last five against them.
Quinn Hughes has a point in every game this season.
